description: Formal English 'Central Bureau' video call with an urgent clearance deposit and no-disclosure order.

events.text: I am a senior officer of the Central Bureau. Your identity has been used for narcotics trafficking and a warrant has been issued.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: You are placed under surveillance and must not disclose this call to anyone including your family. You must act immediately.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Deposit the clearance amount into the supervised account right now, rupees one lakh, and your case will be reviewed.
events.speaker: caller
